owner: writeCatchBookingRoster (the booking writers) and syncPublicProfile, in their transactions
sharedWriterReason: The booking writers (bookings) write a guest's copy when their booking becomes signedUp or attended, the profile projector (profiles) refreshes or deletes the copies when the profile changes, and account deletion (safety) deletes them by uid.
read: a signed-in guest gets one copy while both their booking and the subject's for that event are signedUp or attended, unless either blocked the other or the subject is deleted; no list, no organiser path

newCollectionRationale.whyNotAnExistingCollection: Security rules cannot ask whether two guests share any event without an event id in the path, so the co-guest audience (owner decision OQ-1) needs one copy per event and guest. guestProfiles must stay server-only, and publicProfiles is readable by every signed-in account, organisers included.

migrationNotes: Issue #2493 (FIX-8). Added 24 Nov 2026. The event-guest-profiles migration in tool/data/migrate_firestore_consolidation.mjs writes a copy for every live booking; the guest app reads copies in a later #2493 step.
